#ISSO LVL ll KIRTLAND I have a call with her today at 5:30pm
#ISSO LVL ll KIRTLAND Was in the hospital and couldn't speak. I have a call with him tomorrow at 11am

Leidos - NGLD - PM - Received feedback from a candidate who interviewed that they are not strong enough for their current ramp up. Had Steph Immediately set the meeting that morning. Mary has to hire 12+ people now, there are 2 major issues for quick hiring, space at the customer site and Volt. 

Hiring - Got her to agree to blocked interview times for Tuesday/Thursday. We will have resumes in volt for her to review by Monday for Tues time and Tues for Wed times. I also got her to commit to one and done interviews instead of the phone screen/onsite method they are currently doing. She wants to do subk and is wants to do it our way, we have all of our SUBk's over to her with the SCA for each one. We will convert this but playing the game right now bc she wants to follow the rules. 

Space - Bc the customer wants them on site, we are spacing out the onboarding and having 3 different start dates I got her to loosely commit on, 3/18 - 3/25- 4-1. I also discuss the nipr/sipr access on Sherman St. we use for NGEN. She didnt know about that and is looking in to it.

Microsoft  - DOD - Biz Apps - Follow Up meeting from the all hand DOD meeting from Friday 2-23. David still assured us we still have to find a champion to get us onboarded to METSS II. His current players are Accenture/KPMG//EY/Carasoft/IG. 

He is still too high up and let us know the relationships (provided names) need to be held at the SSP Level for DIB, Joint DOD(DHA,DISA,SOCOM)/ARMY/NAVY/USMC/USAF. This goes for BIZ APPS, CYBER, MODERN WORK, and AZURE BU's. All of their funding goes through IT Service Agreements through METTS and they prefer to use partner rather than ISD, ISD is only interested in $1m+ deals. We asked him directly the best way to get on METSS and the he said last Friday was the start of it, we have the intro, get the opportunity (RFP/RFI), do a good job, and they will continue to feed us the work. He did mention there is opportunity to go get post award work, something we have struggled with and great to hear bc we have been told non stop that they only use their partners they bring on to the their programs.
